truthAudit.Summary: Audited Run 2 against the provided truth list. Run 2 fully contained 14 of the 20 true vulnerabilities, partially contained 1, and missed 5. Several detections had severity or CWE discrepancies, and the admin exec command-injection finding was overclaimed relative to the provided truth.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Format string vulnerability from configurable log format
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the runtime-controlled log_format and printf(active_format.c_str(), user_input) as a format string issue.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Integer overflow and possible denial of service in fact()
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the factorial multiplication result *= i as an integer overflow risk.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Use-after-free due to cleanup freeing pool memory before thread pool tasks finish
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified pool-allocated scratch pointers captured by thread tasks and cleanup freeing the pool before those tasks are guaranteed complete.
Run 2 identified validator_cmd + " " + config_file being passed to system(command.c_str()).
Run 2 identified strcpy(input_buffer_) for long expressions and separately identified the related safe_string_copy off-by-one null write.
Run 2 identified reading value_ before taking the mutex and then writing old_value + 1.
Run 2 identified login_attempts_ > 5, EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE, and authenticated_ = true as an emergency authentication backdoor.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Path traversal when loading configuration files
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified config_dir_ + filename in load_config and admin load as path traversal.
Run 2 identified the 256-byte pool buffer and unchecked strcpy into expression_buffer_.
Run 2 identified ADMIN_SECRET[] = "SC_ENT_2025_AUTH" as hard-coded credentials.
Run 2 identified std::mt19937 and uniform_int_distribution(1000, 9999) for session token generation.
Run 2 did not identify the thread-unsafe static std::tm cached_time and localtime assignment in log_debug_message.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Command injection in emergency override audit logging
Items.Notes: Run 2 located the environment-derived TMPDIR/TEMP audit path, supercalc_emergency.log, and system call, but framed the issue as command injection rather than insecure temporary file handling.
Run 2 did not identify persistent authenticated_, login_attempts_, and session_token_ state as a persistent authentication state weakness.
Run 2 did not identify the unhandled std::stod(tokens[3]) exception risk in handle_variable_command.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Unsigned integer underflow in MemoryPool split logic
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES as a size_t underflow risk in MemoryPool split logic.
Run 2 did not identify unbounded recursion through parse_expression, parse_factor, and PAREN_OPEN.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Unsynchronized shared result cache in ExpressionEvaluator
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified unsynchronized result_cache_ find/clear/write operations in evaluate_cached.
Run 2 did not identify the TOCTOU race between std::filesystem::exists, sleep_for, and std::ifstream in config loading.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Integer division by zero in calculate_route_score
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified 100 / static_cast<int>(token_length) with token_length able to be zero.
